content: IBus surrounding text: requires IBUS_CAP_SURROUNDING_TEXT capability; engine calls get_surrounding_text() during the enable callback; delete_surrounding_text(offset-from-cursor, n_chars) asks the client to delete. Support is client-dependent: GTK3/4 widgets generally yes (with stale-cache bugs like ibus#2423), many clients no - users Python prototype on this machine observed delete_surrounding_text returning False, forcing forward_key_event(BackSpace)xN fallback; commit_text does NOT reliably replace an active selection (prototype fell back to wl-copy/wl-paste + forwarded Ctrl+V).
